title: Publish canonical Claude launch bounds and resume vocabulary
description: OBJECTIVE: remove the second hard prerequisite blocking task-9a1eb61d: @moe/runner currently keeps the four Claude launch ceilings inline/private and withholds the already-authoritative resume-flag roster, so a daemon producer must either copy runner authority or guess. CURRENT-BYTE EVIDENCE at HEAD 2f205e0209448ed67fd934937d1a96a74dd4639f: `claude-launcher-input.ts` alone enforces stdoutBytes/stderrBytes/tailBytes/timeoutMs <= 1_048_576/1_048_576/65_536/600_000; `CLAUDE_LAUNCH_RESUME_FLAGS` exists once in `claude-launch-selection.ts` as `--resume,-r,--continue,-c,--from-pr,--cloud` and is consumed by the real verifier, but neither the ceilings nor resume roster is root-public. DELIVERABLE: a pure total public limit admission surface in the existing launcher-input module, the exact existing resume roster and limit vocabulary curated through the real @moe/runner root, and the real launch-request snapshot refactored to consume the same limit validator so only one production authority exists. Preserve the deliberate withholding of `snapshotLaunchSelection` and `verifyLaunchSelection`. NOT IN SCOPE: daemon code, model/profile selection, process launch behavior, new defaults, or weakening the launch-selection gate. CONSUMER: task-9a1eb61d566e47838c9f79c030da1f70; eventual production composition remains task-a9fd91c373c244c78df97945965a8038.
definitionOfDone: `claude-launcher-input.ts` exports one frozen `CLAUDE_LAUNCH_LIMIT_CEILINGS` table, closed field/code/layer vocabularies, and total `validateClaudeLaunchLimits(value)` returning a detached frozen `ClaudeLaunchLimits` or exact `CLAUDE_LAUNCH_LIMITS_MALFORMED`, `CLAUDE_LAUNCH_LIMIT_INVALID`, or `CLAUDE_LAUNCH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` at layer `LAUNCH_LIMITS`, with the offending field (null only for whole-record shape failure).

`snapshotClaudeLaunchRequest` delegates all four limit decisions to `validateClaudeLaunchLimits`; the previous inline numeric/ceiling comparisons are removed, and no second ceiling literal or validator remains in production.

The curated @moe/runner root exports the validator/table/type closure and the existing exact six-member `CLAUDE_LAUNCH_RESUME_FLAGS` roster while continuing to withhold `snapshotLaunchSelection` and `verifyLaunchSelection`; real Node/root namespace tests prove every exported runtime binding is defined.

Tests assert a nonzero exact four-field table, N accepted and N+1 refused for each literal ceiling with exact code+layer+field, hostile/malformed/nonpositive inputs, and the real request-snapshot path; mutation drills changing each ceiling, bypassing the validator, and deleting `--cloud` each redden a named production-surface assertion.

Every touched production source remains <=250 physical lines and existing bridges remain byte-exact LF; standalone @moe/runner typecheck and test legs record separate exit codes, and the test output contains nonzero Test Files/Tests counts.
taskRails: Do not copy or restamp the resume roster: re-export the existing `CLAUDE_LAUNCH_RESUME_FLAGS` used by the real verifier.
Do not publish `snapshotLaunchSelection` or `verifyLaunchSelection`; the launcher remains the only authority that applies them to the actual request.
Do not add daemon policy/default values or change process-launch behavior; this slice only publishes and single-sources existing runner constraints.
Pin exact stable code, layer, and field on every failure; generated/boundary tables must assert their exact positive cardinality.
Preserve shared-worktree foreign bytes and commit only explicit owned paths.
